proposal.description: The asynchronous reset clears the two fault counts but not the two window shift registers. The designer relies on the idle clear to zero the windows after reset is released.
proposal.reason: If ss_active (or run_active) is high on the first clock after reset is released, the idle clear never runs. The first pwm_rise then subtracts an uninitialised leaving bit from the count, so fault_count_ss_out, fault_count_run_out and the trips are wrong from the first sample.

proposal.description: The PWM edge detector's delayed copy pwm_sync_d is updated only while the converter is switching (S_SS or S_RUN). Through idle and hiccup it holds the PWM level from the last switching clock.
proposal.reason: Suppose S_SS is entered while pwm_sync is already high and S_RUN was last left while it was low. The stale pwm_sync_d makes pwm_rise fire on the first S_SS clock, so the soft-start window takes a spurious sample and fault_count_ss_out and window_trip_SS change. In the opposite case a real rising edge on the entry clock is missed.
